paradigm: Functional core + imperative shell with hexagonal seams at external boundaries (NDK, IDB, NIP-46 signer)

idb_pattern.description: All IDB stores use createKVStore(name) which opens a separate idb-keyval database per store named 'notestr-<name>'. No versioned migrations — idb-keyval manages a fixed version-1 schema. The new notestr-failed-welcomes store follows this exact pattern.

dom_event_pattern.description: Write IDB first, then window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('notestr:<name>-changed')). No detail payload — consumers re-read from IDB. Consumed via window.addEventListener in device-sync.ts:1052. Test shim: global.window = new EventTarget().

similar_features.closest_analogue_module: src/marmot/forgotten-slots.ts — IDB store + DOM event dispatch + listener. failed-welcomes.ts mirrors this structure exactly.

settings_modal.extension_pattern: Add <TabsTrigger> + <TabsContent> pair. No other wiring needed. Props available via useMarmot() inside child components.

forgetSelfDevice.signature: async function forgetSelfDevice(client: MarmotClient, signer: EventSigner, relays: string[], onSignOut: () => void): Promise<void>
forgetSelfDevice.note: All four args available from useMarmot().

handleDisconnect.description: Synchronous. Sets signer/pubkey/authMethod/selectedGroup to null. No MLS cleanup. SettingsModal receives it as onSignOut at page.tsx:574.

similar_features.no_toast_system: No toast library installed. Use inline banner pattern from DevicesTab.tsx:274-288 (aria-live='polite' region, text-destructive div). The signin-time prompt must use this pattern or introduce a new component.

architecture.dominant_paradigm: Functional core (marmot .ts modules — no React) + imperative shell (client.tsx, device-sync.ts — React hooks + subscriptions) + presentation layer (src/components/ — useMarmot() only)

data_available_at_catch.invite: Rumor (kind-444) — sufficient for client.readInviteGroupInfo(invite) to get group name/relays/admins
data_available_at_catch.err: Error with messages 'No matching KeyPackage found in local store...' or 'Failed to join group with any matching key package. Last error: ...'
data_available_at_catch.client: available in outer closure — can call client.readInviteGroupInfo(invite)
data_available_at_catch.gift_wrap_event_id: NOT available — the kind-1059 outer event was consumed before this function was called. invite.id is the Rumor ID. ARCHITECT MUST verify whether invite.id equals the gift-wrap ID (some invite managers store by gift-wrap ID) or whether a new field is needed.

joinFromWelcomeInvite.critical_ordering: The failed-welcome record MUST be written BEFORE inviteReader.markAsRead(invite.id) — after mark-as-read, the invite will not be replayed.

inviteReaderOnError.callback_signature: (error: Error, eventId: string) — eventId IS the gift-wrap (kind-1059) event ID
inviteReaderOnError.description: Fires when a gift wrap fails to decrypt/parse. Rumor NOT available (decryption failed). Only err + eventId accessible.

client_init_lifecycle.background_iife_at: lines 283-389 — runs after loading:false; KP creation/rotation, stale-KP deletion, kind-10051 publish
client_init_lifecycle.probe_insertion_point: Add as a parallel IIFE after line 243 (loading:false) and alongside the existing background IIFE at line 283

actual_signed_kinds: kind 22242 via NDK AUTH (needs perms even though no direct signEvent call — NDK calls signer internally)

architecture.sibling_slots_source: Re-query relay for kind-30443 events by user pubkey — same query DevicesTab uses at lines 162-175. The internal knownEvents map in device-sync.ts is not exported.
architecture.groupHasKeyPackageLeaf: Exported from device-sync.ts:394-408. Signature: groupHasKeyPackageLeaf(state: ClientState, keyPackageEvent: NostrEvent): boolean

testing_and_conventions.test_runner: Vitest 4.1.0, environment: node (not jsdom), globals: false — explicit import of describe/it/expect/vi from vitest
testing_and_conventions.make_test: npm run test:unit (vitest run) && npm run test:export
testing_and_conventions.no_component_tests: No .test.tsx files. All unit tests are .test.ts. Component verification via E2E (Playwright).

idb_mock_patterns.simple: module-level Map + vi.mock('./storage', ...) factory — see device-store.test.ts:3-37
idb_mock_patterns.proxy: vi.hoisted() + proxy store + storeRef.current swap in beforeEach — see forgotten-slots.test.ts:22-53
idb_mock_patterns.in_memory: storage.ts:144-169 exports createInMemoryKVStore<T>() for production-quality in-memory testing

testing_and_conventions.mock_ordering: vi.mock() calls must come before all imports (see forget-device.test.ts:15-59). Vitest hoists vi.mock but imports must come after.
testing_and_conventions.window_shim: global.window = new EventTarget() needed in node env when testing dispatchEvent (forgotten-slots.test.ts:73)
testing_and_conventions.typescript: ES2022 target, lib: [ES2022, DOM, DOM.Iterable], strict: true, isolatedModules: true. @/* alias → ./src/*.
testing_and_conventions.styling: Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui components (src/components/ui/). cn() for class merging. No CSS modules.
testing_and_conventions.file_naming: kebab-case .ts for marmot modules. Co-located tests: <module>.test.ts. No barrel files anywhere.
conventions: No barrel files — import specific module files
@/ alias for cross-directory imports from components to marmot
All marmot .ts modules: no React imports, no 'use client'
Components with hooks: 'use client' as first line
Named exports only — no default exports
JSDoc boundary rules block at top of each marmot module
AC reference tags in test names: it('does X (AC-LOG-1, AC-LOG-2)', ...)
testing_and_conventions.e2e_cleanup: e2e/fixtures/cleanup.ts:16-28 KNOWN_IDB_NAMES — must add 'notestr-failed-welcomes' when the new store is created
